title: What the Window Does Not Contain: Auditing Provenance in a Document-Grounded Instability Benchmark
abstract: arXiv:2609.06147v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Ask a language model the same question about the same document twenty times, and it sometimes returns two different answers. We built Probity, a benchmark of 60 tasks and 470 items from real venture-financing filings, to measure how often this happens. Then we audited our own corpus and found a defect any excerpt-built benchmark can carry: items whose evidence is missing from the window of text the model is shown. The audit flags 36 items and separates two failures a single flag would conflate: evidence genuinely absent from the window and answers that must be computed from numbers the window does supply. Flagged items change their answers far more often, wobbling at 0.255 against 0.087 on the 427 clean items, and excluding them cuts apparent cross-model agreement by about a fifth. translated_title: 窗口未含之物：在基于文档的答案不稳定性基准中审计证据溯源
translated_abstract: 对同一份文档，向语言模型询问同一个问题二十次，它有时会返回两个不同的答案。我们构建了Probity——一个包含来自真实风险融资文件、共60个任务和470个条目的基准——来衡量这种情况发生的频率。随后我们对自己的语料库进行了审计，发现了一种任何由摘录构建的基准都可能存在的缺陷：某些条目的证据缺失于展示给模型的文本窗口之中。该审计标记了36个条目，并将单一标记容易混淆的两种失败情形区分开来：证据真正缺失于窗口之外，以及必须从窗口所提供的数字中计算得出的答案。被标记条目改变答案的频率要高得多——其不稳定率达0.255，而427个干净条目仅为0.087；排除这些条目会使表面上的跨模型一致性下降约五分之一。在检验缺失证据是否能够解释这种不稳定性之前，我们预先注册了一项预测：重新裁剪每个窗口使其包含证据，不稳定……
tldr: 论文构建了基于真实风投融资文件的稳定性基准Probity，并通过自我审计揭示了摘录式基准中的证据溯源缺陷——证据缺失于模型文本窗口的条目答案不稳定性远高于正常条目（0.255对0.087），且会虚增跨模型一致性约五分之一。
en_tdlr: The paper builds Probity, a benchmark of 60 tasks and 470 items from real venture-financing filings for measuring LLM answer instability, and its self-audit reveals that items whose evidence is missing from the model's text window wobble far more (0.255 vs 0.087) and inflate apparent cross-model agreement by about a fifth, distinguishing genuinely absent evidence from computable answers.
